candidates.title: Chicken salad

method: Use chilled, already-cooked chicken breast. Wash and dry salad leaves and tomato unless the packet says ready washed; slice the tomato.
Put the chicken and salad on a plate and add the measured mayonnaise. Eat now, or cover and refrigerate promptly as described below.
food_safety: Check every bought ingredient label for allergens and use-by dates. These recipes do not guarantee allergy suitability.
Use clean hands, utensils and surfaces. Keep chilled ready-to-eat ingredients refrigerated until assembly.

storage.chilled: Cover and refrigerate promptly at 0–5°C. Eat within 24 hours of assembly or any earlier ingredient use-by or after-opening deadline; keep chilled until eating. If using home-cooked chicken, it must have been cooled and refrigerated within 2 hours of cooking and used within 48 hours of original cooking; assembling this meal does not restart that clock.

candidates.title: Beans on toast

method: Heat the canned baked beans according to the packet instructions, stirring as directed, until steaming hot throughout. Use a microwave-safe bowl if microwaving.
Meanwhile toast two slices of wholemeal bread weighing 80g in total. Spoon the hot beans over the toast and eat immediately. Appliance and packet times govern; the total time is an estimate.
food_safety: Check every bought ingredient label for allergens and use-by dates. These recipes do not guarantee allergy suitability.
Use clean hands, utensils and surfaces. Keep chilled ready-to-eat ingredients refrigerated until assembly.

storage.chilled: Eat immediately after cooking. These instructions do not cover storing or reheating the finished meal.

candidates.title: Scrambled eggs on toast

method: Crack two medium eggs into a bowl and beat in the measured milk. Nutrition assumes about 100g of edible egg without shells; actual egg sizes vary. Wash hands and utensils after handling raw eggs.
Heat the measured oil in a non-stick pan over a low to medium heat. Add the eggs and stir gently until fully set throughout. Meanwhile toast two slices of bread weighing 80g in total.
Spoon the cooked eggs onto the toast and eat immediately. The total time is an estimate; fully set eggs govern doneness.
food_safety: Check every bought ingredient label for allergens and use-by dates. These recipes do not guarantee allergy suitability.
Use clean hands, utensils and surfaces. Keep chilled ready-to-eat ingredients refrigerated until assembly.

storage.chilled: Eat immediately after cooking. These instructions do not cover storing or reheating the finished meal.
